english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something is wholly or completely so.

exampleSentences.english: I have no idea at all where they went.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我完全唔知佢哋去咗邊。

english.note: Use 完全 as the all-purpose adverb for totality, including being completely broke.
This is the all-purpose choice for “completely,” as in 完全清醒 for “wide awake.”

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose adverb for “completely” or “entirely.”

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when “perfectly” means completely or totally, especially before an adjective or verb phrase.

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for both “thoroughly” and “totally,” including “completely mad.”
